title: Whitespace check diffs the local git checkout, so CI must keep the base revision fetched
answers: whitespace check fails with a git error in lint CI
lint job breaks after shallow checkout change
PR whitespace-only check reports no diff or crashes
body:
Invariant: dev/check_whitespace_only.py no longer downloads the PR .diff from GitHub. get_pr_diff(base_revision) runs `git diff --no-ext-diff --no-color <base>...HEAD` in the local clone.
Enforced by: dev/check_whitespace_only.py:get_pr_diff and parse_args (--base-revision is required).
CI wiring: .github/workflows/lint.yml passes `--base-revision HEAD^1`; that revision only exists because the checkout uses `fetch-depth: 2`.
What breaks if skipped: lowering fetch-depth to 1 or removing the base fetch makes git diff fail (subprocess.CalledProcessError, no fallback), and the lint step errors instead of checking the PR.
Keep the lint.yml fetch depth and the --base-revision value changed together.
applies: Any change to the lint job checkout step, or to how check_whitespace_only.py obtains the diff.
says: Pull request lint workflow crashes with a git diff error during validation.
Code formatting check fails in continuous integration on shallow git checkouts.
Whitespace validation job errors out instead of reviewing pull request changes.
Ensure the pull request linting pipeline fetches enough commit history to compare.
search: In dev/check_whitespace_only.py, get_pr_diff runs a local git diff against a required --base-revision rather than downloading the PR diff from GitHub. The workflow .github/workflows/lint.yml supplies --base-revision HEAD^1, which requires fetch-depth: 2 in the checkout step. Lowering fetch-depth to 1 causes git diff to fail with subprocess.CalledProcessError and aborts the lint step, so fetch depth and --base-revision must be updated together.
